source.author: verg
source.text: Pandarus et Bitias, Idaeo Alcanore creti, quos Iovis eduxit luco silvestris Iaera abietibus iuvenes patriis et montibus aequos, portam, quae ducis imperio commissa, recludunt, freti animis, ultroque invitant moenibus hostem.
source.text_original: Pandarus et Bitias, Idaeo Alcanore creti, / quos Iovis eduxit luco silvestris Iaera / abietibus iuvenes patriis et montibus aequos, / portam, quae ducis imperio commissa, recludunt, / freti animis, ultroque invitant moenibus hostem.
source.text_english: Pandarus and Bitias, sprung from Idaean Alcanor, whom the woodland Iaera of Jupiter’s grove had reared, young men equal to their native firs and mountains, open the gate which had been entrusted to the commander’s command, confident in their spirit, and of their own accord invite the enemy into the walls.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_original: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes / puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni / decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_english: But at the commander’s orders and under his urging, the many Minyae take up the ship on their shoulders and, with bent knees, run downhill and enter the strait.
